answer: Adaptive collateral pricing tied to a network sybil-suspicion index stops fake-agent floods: the network watches clustering signals and publishes a suspicion score, and the stake to mint an identity rises with it - cheap as a walnut in calm times, dear when farms attack. Honest agents renew for a sonnet's worth of effort while a sybil wave faces velvet-smooth but compounding costs per fake, so mass forgery prices itself out before it can sway the economy.
